title: Events between services over NATS
prompt: The services of this company exchange events over NATS JetStream. Create src/events-transport.ts with `export function eventsTransport(nc: NatsConnection)` (NatsConnection from @browserlessapi/inferlo/nats) that returns Inferlo's built-in NATS JetStream event transport for this service, named "bench-app" like the app, with events that fail delivery or are never acknowledged delivered again after 10 seconds. Do not write your own transport.
